contracts.source: American Electric Power press release: AEP Partners with Amazon and X-energy to Explore Advanced (10-19-2026)
contracts.signal: AEP announced a joint development agreement with X-energy to evaluate the feasibility of constructing a 960-megawatt advanced nuclear project using X-energy's Xe-100 small modular reactors at the former Breed Generating Station site of Indiana Michigan Power in Sullivan County, Indiana; the initial project would include 12 Xe-100 units of 80 MW each, configured in groups of four. Construction depends on the project reaching a final investment decision.

connects_to.relationship: electric service to Amazon data-center load in Northwest Louisiana (SPP)

contracts.source: American Electric Power press release: AEP Partners with Amazon and X-energy to Explore Advanced (10-19-2026)
contracts.signal: Amazon is supporting the development of AEP's potential 960 MW X-energy Xe-100 advanced nuclear project in Sullivan County, Indiana through a funding agreement and intends to purchase the power under a long-term contract covering the costs of the facility and its operations for the duration of the contract, if the project reaches a final investment decision and is built. AEP CEO Bill Fehrman: the agreements with Amazon and X-energy will provide all necessary capital protections and financial safeguards that AEP has said are essential for any potential nuclear project.
contracts.type: development funding agreement and intended long-term power purchase
